task: Research zero-capital monetization mechanics for Real's Facebook Pages network + Instagram, and DM/inbox automation options
resume_brief: Research task: find concrete, zero-capital ways Real can make money from his Facebook Pages network (M. Heaven$ent live first; 12 more pages gated by Facebook page-creation cooldown) and Instagram @m2villainous (dormant, 215 followers), plus DM/inbox automation options. Constraints: owner is broke — no ad spend, no paid tools. Nothing publishes without his approval. Deliverable: a ranked list of monetization mechanics (Facebook Reels bonuses/Stars/subscriptions/affiliate/tip flows/etc.) with what is real vs hype, effort required, platform-rule safety, and realistic time-to-first-dollar; plus DM/inbox automation plays (lead-gen, offers, outreach flows) that are rule-safe. Write findings to ~/workspace/money/MONEY-MECHANICS.md and report back a tight summary. Do not post, publish, or contact anyone.
